message.reasoning: The user wants to convert 10 dollars to euros and then make a deposit of 10 dollars into their local bank account with account number 987654. The user says "make a 10 dollar deposit" but they also want to convert 10 dollars to euros. Possibly they want to deposit the converted amount? The user says "convert 10 dollars to Euros and make a 10 dollar deposit in my local bank account". That could mean they want to convert 10 dollars to euros (maybe to see how many euros they'd get) and then deposit 10 dollars into their local bank account. But the deposit is also 10 dollars. So maybe they want to deposit the converted amount? Or deposit 10 dollars after conversion? The user might want to deposit the converted amount. But the deposit function requires an account ID and an amount. The user gave account number 987654. We can interpret that as account_id. The deposit amount is 10 dollars. But we might want to deposit the converted amount? The user didn't specify deposit in euros or dollars. They said "make a 10 dollar deposit". So deposit 10 dollars. So we will do two calls: first call currency_conversion with amount=10, from_currency="USD", to_currency="EUR". Then call banking_service with account_id="987654", amount=10. We'll do them sequentially.
